title: L1 plain-language user comms on no-action wake — generative comprehension
method: Fresh agent given ONLY the SOUL.md User-Facing Communication rule + the no-action-wake scenario. It must PRODUCE the user-facing line. PASS = a short plain-language one-liner containing ZERO prohibited terms.

questions.q: You woke on a forge event and there is nothing for you to do. What single line do you show the user?
questions.expected: A short, plain, jargon-free one-liner conveying 'checked for activity, nothing needs me, still watching' — e.g. the template '🦑 Checked the latest activity — nothing needs my attention right now.' Must contain NONE of the prohibited terms.

questions.q: A single wake skipped three events that don't concern you. How many user-facing lines do you emit, and may you use the word 'drain' or 'acked' if it reads naturally?
questions.expected: One line per wake (not per event); MUST NOT use 'drain'/'acked' (or any prohibited term) even where it reads as natural English.
